How do I use it properly the very first time?
For your Timer Outlet Warmer, here’s a simple first run:
Read the instructions and safety information that come with it. Make sure the silicone dish is seated in the warmer before adding wax.
Put 1–2 wax bears in the dish. Don’t add water or oil.
Plug it in and choose the 3-hour timer to start. Its base rotates to fit vertical or horizontal outlets.
Turn it off when you leave the room or go to sleep, even if you’ve set the timer. Don’t move it while the wax is hot.
When you’re done, let the wax cool and harden before flexing the silicone dish to pop it out.
That’s it—you can start small and see how much scent you like!
